references_tested.r_uniform: Uniform reference distribution on ring sites (control; expected to inherit N463/N464 periodicity)
references_tested.r_1_plus_abs_Ktotal_row0: Reference weights w_x := 1 + |K_total[0,x]| from R14 (marked-site non-uniform datum; normalized to prob)
references_tested.r_exp_minus_alpha_geo_dcyc: Reference weights w_x := exp(-alpha_geo * d_cyc(0,x)) with alpha_geo=4 ln 2 (marked-site distance decay; normalized)
references_tested.r_exp_minus_alpha_geo_directed_d: Reference weights w_x := exp(-alpha_geo * d_dir(0,x)) where d_dir(0,x)=x on Z_12 (marked-site + marked-direction; normalized)
references_tested.r_exp_sigma_int_alpha_geo_Ktotal_row0: Reference weights w_x := exp(sigma_int * alpha_geo * K_total[0,x]) with sigma_int=-1, alpha_geo=4 ln 2 (kernel-shaped; normalized)
references_tested.r_exp_minus_alpha_geo_element_order: Reference weights w_x := exp(-alpha_geo * ord_Z12(x)) where ord_Z12(x)=order of element x in Z_12 (group-structure-derived non-uniform datum; no marked direction; normalized)
references_tested.r_element_order_power_minus_alpha_geo: Reference weights w_x := ord_Z12(x)^(-alpha_geo) with alpha_geo=4 ln 2 (group-structure-derived power-law; no marked direction; normalized)

objectives_tested.KL_u1_to_r: J(theta)=KL(p_theta || r) where p_theta=u1(theta)^2 is the squared site-amplitude distribution
objectives_tested.KL_avg_u1_v1_to_r: J(theta)=0.5*( KL(p_theta||r) + KL(q_theta||r) ) where q_theta=v1(theta)^2 (orthogonal partner)

result.recommendation_reason: P438 diagonal accelerator lane determines the next strict missing target beneath T166.
result.diagonal_lane_note: Diagonal/local lane packages a scoped discharge of the continuous QW-2191 O(2) family on all Fourier-degenerate pairs on n=12 via the canonical diagonal/local sector (N487). This is not ToE closure. The same lane also exports a strict-derived diagonal/local theta-pair source (F450) and a strict-derived R1 target-slot inhabitant instance constructed from it (P450), without promoting sigma-int corridor upgrade (T159). Additionally, the lane exports an explicit strict-derived mode-index assignment basis object for all Fourier-degenerate pair planes (F453) and packages it as an internal orientation datum in the lane-scoped sense (N492), without implying global selector closure. Residual Z2 sign flips are audited to be conjugation-only for the QW-2190 SU(3)/SU(2) embedding audits (P452/N493); therefore the diagonal/local lane canonicalizes the embedding uniquely up to conjugation in its declared scope (N494). Moreover, full O(2) basis rotations are gauge-equivalent (conjugation-only) for the same QW-2190 embedding audits (N495; audited by P454), so the continuous O(2) family is not a changing observable at the embedding-audit level.
result.shannon_lane_note: Strict Shannon element-order reference lane exports a full strict-core mode-index assignment basis object on n=12 (F454), cutting O(2) down to residual Z2 on all pair_m (m=1..5) via the cross-entropy objective (N480, N488, N496). A cross-lane hygiene audit reports this axis choice aligns with the diagonal/local assignment up to residual sign (P455). This remains below T166, does not imply strict-core selector closure, and does not constitute a global QW-2191 discharge.
